items.t: Death wobble front-end shake
items.job: Replace front track bar and inspect steering parts
items.note: Alignment usually needed after. Cost rises if tie rods, ball joints or the steering damper are also worn.

items.t: Oil leaks from rear main seal, valve cover and oil pan
items.job: Replace rear main seal and oil pan gasket
items.note: A valve cover gasket leak alone costs much less. Fixing all leaks in one visit saves labor.

items.t: Radiator leaks where the plastic tank meets the core
items.job: Replace radiator
items.note: Includes refilling coolant. Replace old hoses and the cap at the same time.

items.t: Frame rust, especially near the rear suspension mounts
items.job: Cut out and weld in rear frame repair sections
items.note: Price is for the rear control arm area. If the frame is rotted throughout, a frame swap costs much more.

items.t: Water leaks into the cab
items.job: Find and reseal leaks at door seals or windshield frame
items.note: Cost depends on where water gets in. Windshield frame seal jobs take the longest.

items.t: Axle pinion seal and transfer case leaks
items.job: Replace axle pinion seal
items.note: Price is per seal. A transfer case output seal costs about the same.

items.t: Vehicle may roll away in Park (recall 05V-460)
items.job: Repair or replace park interlock or shift cable
items.note: Free under recall 05V-460 if not done yet. Check the VIN with a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Fuel spills back out of the filler while refueling
items.job: Replace clogged EVAP canister or fuel tank vent valve
items.note: If the filler neck itself is damaged, it may need replacing too.

items.t: Fuse box module (TIPM) causes odd electrical faults
items.job: Replace TIPM with a rebuilt or new module
items.note: Rebuilt modules cost less than new. Rule out bad grounds and the fuel pump relay first.

items.t: Airbag light from steering wheel clockspring (recall 16V-290)
items.job: Replace steering wheel clockspring
items.note: Covered by recall for affected Wranglers. Check the VIN with a Jeep dealer first.

items.t: Left cylinder head valve seat problem (warranty extension)
items.job: Replace left cylinder head with updated design
items.note: A warranty extension covers many 2012-2013 V6 engines. Ask a Jeep dealer to check your VIN.

items.t: Cracked oil filter and cooler housing
items.job: Replace oil filter and cooler housing
items.note: An aluminum aftermarket housing is a common upgrade. Newer Jeeps may still be under warranty.

items.t: Front track bar bracket weld (recall 18V-675)
items.job: Inspect and repair front track bar frame bracket
items.note: Free under recall 18V-675 for affected Jeeps. Check the VIN with a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Loose, wandering steering from the steering gear (TSBs)
items.job: Replace steering gear box
items.note: Alignment needed after. Some cases are fixed by adjustment under the bulletins, so ask the dealer.

items.t: Manual clutch overheating (recalls)
items.job: Replace clutch pressure plate and disc
items.note: Recalls cover software and clutch parts on affected manual Jeeps. Check the VIN with a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Shifter shows Park when not locked (recall 18V-280)
items.job: Repair shifter linkage so Park fully engages
items.note: Free under recall 18V-280. Check the VIN with a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Cruise control may not cancel (recall 18V-332)
items.job: Reprogram engine computer software
items.note: Free under recall 18V-332. Check the VIN with a Jeep dealer.

items.t: 8-speed shift problems and shudder (TSB)
items.job: Update transmission software and relearn shifts
items.note: If internal parts are damaged, transmission repair or replacement costs much more. Ask about warranty.

items.t: Coolant leak at the water pump inlet (TSB)
items.job: Replace leaking coolant inlet hose or housing
items.note: If the water pump itself is leaking, expect more labor.

items.t: Instrument cluster can go blank (recall 24V-652)
items.job: Update instrument cluster software
items.note: Free under recall 24V-652. If the cluster itself must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump failure (recalls)
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump and flush fuel system
items.note: Recalls cover affected EcoDiesels. If metal debris spread through the fuel system, cost rises a lot.

items.t: 4xe engine debris can cause engine failure (recall 25V-766)
items.job: Replace engine (long block)
items.note: The recall covers inspection and engine replacement if needed. Check the VIN with a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Power steering pump wiring fire risk (recall 26V-363)
items.job: Repair power steering pump wiring and fuse
items.note: Free under recall 26V-363. If the pump itself is damaged, cost rises.

items.t: Lifter tick on the 3.8L V6 can end in engine damage
items.job: Replace lifters, pushrods and camshaft
items.note: Caught early it may be lifters and pushrods only. Once the cam is damaged the heads usually come off as well.

items.t: 3.8L V6 uses up engine oil between changes
items.job: Oil consumption test, then breather valve and spark plugs
items.note: This is the diagnosis and the cheap fixes. Piston ring or short block work is a much bigger job.
